newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner awards offshore deal to Daewoo.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner awards offshore deal to Daewoo.

text.p: Norwegian engineering and construction group Kvaerner ASA has awarded a 550 million crown ($82.4 million) offshore contract to Daewoo Heavy Industries, Oslo Bourse said in a statement on Monday.

"Kvaerner has signed a contract for Daewoo Heavy Industries to build the hull for the Aasgard B platform. The contract is worth about 550 million crowns. The hull is to be delivered in Stavanger in August 1999," the statement said.

Kvaerner last month won a $1 billion contract to build the largest ever floating gas production platform for Norway's offshore Aasgard development. The contract was awarded by state Norwegian oil company Den norske stats oljeselskap AS.
Kvaerner will be responsible for project management, engineering, construction and installation of the Aasgard B gas platform, the first such structure on the Norwegian shelf.
Construction will begin in March 1998 at Kvaerner Rosenborg's yard in Stavanger on the west coast of Norway.
